title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-05
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional 11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a soaring 1969 show featuring a blazing Dark Star, an epic That's It for the Other One and a majestic Cryptical Reprise, with crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a major upgrade with superb, almost pristine soundboard quality that lets listeners hear every nuance. Musically the night shines thanks to a thunderous Dark Star, a complete That's It for the Other One, and extended, magical sequences like China Cat > Top of the World and Cryptical Reprise, making it a must‑hear June 1969 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are overwhelmingly positive about both the performance (standout improvisations and rare song completions) and the audio quality (significant upgrade, crystal‑clear soundboard), giving a clear consensus for a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as 'absolutely great', a major improvement over previous copies, with crisp clarity that captures the band's dynamics.

standout_songs: That's It for the Other One
HE HAD TO DIE (The Other One segment)
China Cat > Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows through extended, high‑energy improvisations and rare full‑suite performances, culminating in a powerful closing sequence that showcases the band's June‑night 1969 chemistry.
